skill.name: code-review
skill.description: Automates pull request review with parallel AI agents, validation passes, and optional GitHub PR comments.
skill.summary: Run high-signal AI code reviews for pull requests before merge.
skill.author: Bind

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown backtick false positives from documentation examples. The confirmed risks are legitimate workflow commands that run Bun and GitHub CLI, including optional commands that post comments to GitHub.

remediation.issue: The skill runs repository-local Bun scripts during review.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before executing the Bun scripts, and document that they run code from the target repository.

remediation.issue: The comment mode posts user-visible content to GitHub.
remediation.suggestion: Keep comment posting behind an explicit --comment flag and preview comments before posting when possible.

content.user_title: Review Pull Requests with AI Agents
content.value_statement: Manual pull request review can miss bugs and policy violations when changes are large. This skill coordinates focused AI reviewers and validators to produce high-signal findings.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether a pull request should be reviewed before starting work.
Discovers relevant AGENTS.md guidance for changed files.
Summarizes pull request title, body, changed files, and diff content.
Runs parallel AI review passes for compliance, bugs, and logic issues.
Validates candidate findings before reporting them.
Can post inline GitHub PR comments when the --comment option is used.
limitations: Requires GitHub CLI authentication and the bundled github-pr skill.
Designed for pull requests, not broad repository audits.
May skip draft, closed, trivial, or already-reviewed pull requests.
Review quality depends on clear PR context and useful AGENTS.md files.

use_cases.title: Pre-merge bug screening
use_cases.description: Run a focused AI review before merging meaningful pull request changes.

use_cases.title: Repository guideline enforcement
use_cases.description: Check changed files against applicable AGENTS.md rules with quoted evidence.

use_cases.title: Reviewer assistance for large diffs
use_cases.description: Summarize changes and surface only validated, high-confidence issues.

prompt_templates.title: Review the current pull request
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a terminal-only review of the current branch PR.

prompt_templates.title: Review and post comments
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when you want validated findings posted as PR comments.

prompt_templates.title: Check guideline compliance before merge
prompt_templates.prompt: Run /code-review and focus on any AGENTS.md compliance issues that are validated by the workflow.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when repository rules matter for the changed files.

prompt_templates.title: Perform a high-signal release review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run /code-review for this release pull request. Report only validated issues that could affect runtime behavior, security, or explicit repository rules.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for important PRs where false positives would slow the team.

output_examples.input: Run a review for the current branch pull request.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes the PR, checks applicable guidelines, validates findings, and reports any high-confidence issues in the terminal.

output_examples.input: Run a review with comments enabled.
output_examples.output: The skill posts one GitHub inline comment for each validated unique issue, or a summary comment when no issues are found.

output_examples.input: Review a draft or already-reviewed pull request.
output_examples.output: The pre-check can stop the workflow and explain why review was skipped.

best_practices: Use the skill on focused pull requests with meaningful changes.
Keep AGENTS.md rules specific, current, and close to the files they govern.
Use --comment only when you are ready to publish findings on GitHub.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as the only review for critical security changes.
Do not run comment mode on shared PRs without expecting public review comments.
Do not rely on vague AGENTS.md guidance for enforceable review findings.

faq.question: Does this skill post comments automatically?
faq.answer: No. It posts GitHub comments only when the --comment option is provided.

faq.question: What tools does it require?
faq.answer: It requires an authenticated GitHub CLI and the bundled github-pr helper skill.

faq.question: Can it review any repository?
faq.answer: It is intended for repositories with GitHub pull requests and compatible local skill scripts.

faq.question: How does it reduce false positives?
faq.answer: It validates candidate issues with follow-up agents and filters low-confidence or pre-existing issues.

faq.question: Does it enforce style preferences?
faq.answer: No. It avoids subjective style feedback unless a relevant AGENTS.md rule explicitly requires it.

faq.question: Is it a replacement for human review?
faq.answer: No. It is a reviewer aid that helps surface likely bugs and explicit guideline violations.
